steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Cook the pasta according to the package directions until tender. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Prepare the garlic
steps.text: Melt the butter in a pan and gently cook the minced garlic.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Add the cream and Parmesan cheese. Stir until the sauce becomes smooth.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Add the cooked pasta and toss everything together. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve warm and top with a little extra Parmesan if desired.

steps.title: Cook the spaghetti
steps.text: Boil the spaghetti until tender, then drain.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.text: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the onion, carrot and bell pepper.

steps.title: Add the sauce
steps.text: Add tomato sauce and season with salt and pepper. Simmer for a few minutes.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Add the spaghetti and mix well. Top with Parmesan if desired.

steps.title: Prepare the chicken
steps.text: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in a pan and cook the chicken until done.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.text: Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened.

steps.title: Add the rice
steps.text: Stir in the rice and chicken stock.

steps.title: Finish cooking
steps.text: Cover and cook until the rice is tender. Serve warm.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Season the chicken and cook in a pan until fully cooked. Slice it into pieces.

steps.title: Prepare the vegetables
steps.text: Chop the lettuce, tomato, cucumber and onion.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Place the vegetables and chicken in a bowl.

steps.title: Add dressing
steps.text: Drizzle with dressing, toss gently and serve.

steps.title: Prepare the base
steps.text: Place the pizza base on a baking tray and spread the tomato sauce over it.

steps.title: Add toppings
steps.text: Add mozzarella and tomato slices. Season lightly with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 200°C until the cheese melts and the crust is golden.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Add fresh basil and drizzle with a little olive oil.

steps.title: Prepare the base
steps.text: Place the pizza base on a baking tray and spread the pesto over it.

steps.title: Add toppings
steps.text: Add mozzarella, tomatoes and mushrooms.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 200°C until the cheese melts and the crust is golden.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with fresh basil and a small drizzle of olive oil.

steps.title: Prepare the mixture
steps.text: Melt the butter and mix it with sugar, eggs and vanilla.

steps.title: Add dry ingredients
steps.text: Stir in cocoa powder, flour and salt until combined.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour into a greased baking pan and bake at 180°C for about 20–25 minutes.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.text: Allow the brownies to cool before cutting them into squares.

steps.title: Mix the wet ingredients
steps.text: Combine melted butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla.

steps.title: Add dry ingredients
steps.text: Stir in flour, cocoa powder and salt.

steps.title: Add chocolate chips
steps.text: Fold in the chocolate chips.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour into a baking pan and bake at 180°C for about 20–25 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Cool before slicing.

steps.title: Mix dry ingredients
steps.text: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.

steps.title: Add wet ingredients
steps.text: Add the egg, milk and melted butter. Mix until just combined.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Pour small amounts of batter into a lightly greased pan.

steps.title: Flip
steps.text: Cook until bubbles appear, then flip and cook the other side.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve warm with fruit, syrup or honey.

steps.title: Mash the banana
steps.text: Mash the banana in a bowl.

steps.title: Make the batter
steps.text: Add the egg and milk. Stir in flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Pour the batter into a lightly greased pan.

steps.title: Flip
steps.text: Cook until bubbles appear, then flip and cook the other side.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve warm with banana slices or a little honey.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the banana, berries, yogurt and milk until thick and smooth.

steps.title: Pour
steps.text: Pour the smoothie mixture into a bowl.

steps.title: Add toppings
steps.text: Slice the kiwi and add it with the extra berries.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.text: Sprinkle a few nuts over the top and serve immediately.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Season both sides of the steak with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Heat the pan
steps.text: Heat the oil in a hot pan.

steps.title: Cook the steak
steps.text: Cook the steak for a few minutes on each side, depending on how well done you prefer it.

steps.title: Add butter
steps.text: Add butter and garlic during the final minute and spoon the melted butter over the steak.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Let the steak rest for a few minutes before serving.

steps.title: Season the salmon
steps.text: Season the salmon with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Cook the salmon
steps.text: Heat oil in a pan and cook the salmon on both sides until done. Remove from the pan.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Cook the garlic and tomatoes for a few minutes. Add cream and Parmesan.

steps.title: Add spinach
steps.text: Stir in the spinach until it becomes soft.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Return the salmon to the pan and spoon the sauce over it. Serve warm.

steps.title: Prepare the cake
steps.text: Cut the chocolate cake into small pieces.

steps.title: Make the first layer
steps.text: Place some cake pieces at the bottom of a glass or serving bowl.

steps.title: Add layers
steps.text: Add chocolate pudding, cherries and whipped cream.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Continue layering until the glass is almost full.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.text: Top with whipped cream, chocolate shavings and a cherry.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
